Mukesh Khanna criticizes Dhruv Rathee and Abhijit Dipke, praises Delhi Police

Veteran actor Mukesh Khanna has criticized YouTuber Dhruv Rathee and Abhijit Dipke, while praising the Delhi Police and government. This statement was made in connection with the 'Cockroach Janata Party's' protest in Delhi. Indian Express journalists observed events on the ground during the protest.
